repo_notes.content: A starter template. The chosen stack — Vite, TanStack Router, Zustand, Tailwind — is the thing being documented, more than any single component.
repo_notes.author: rei-doc-specialist

repo_notes.content: Routing is file-driven under src/routes/; explain that convention before listing components.
repo_notes.author: rei-doc-specialist

pages.title: Application Architecture
pages.purpose: The stack and how it fits together: Vite build, TanStack Router, Zustand stores, Tailwind styling, and the app entrypoint.

pages.title: Routing
pages.purpose: The routes under src/routes/: the routing convention, nested layouts, loaders and navigation.

pages.title: Components
pages.purpose: The components under src/components/: composition patterns, prop conventions and the styling approach.

pages.title: State Management
pages.purpose: The Zustand stores under src/stores/: what belongs in global state, store shape and selector patterns.

pages.title: Hooks and Services
pages.purpose: The custom hooks under src/hooks/ and the service layer under src/services/ that talks to a backend.

pages.title: Testing
pages.purpose: The Vitest and Testing Library setup and what the component, hook, store and service tests cover.
